verdicts.reason: A: the SOLSTICE wordmark floats to the left of the two-line headline instead of sitting above it. The badges are blown up to the same size as the CTA, and the CTA is stacked under a badge, so hierarchy is muddled. There is a dead gap between the phone and the text, and empty space trails off to the right. B: it reads left to right like a proper banner, with a one-line headline and the badges in a row leading to the CTA. However, the background circle is stretched into an oval, the phone touches the top and bottom edges, and the CTA is jammed against the right edge with its label nearly filling the pill.
